objective: Establish the provider-neutral external API/MCP fabric and first academic Reach provider wave without changing authority boundaries.

rulesConsidered: External APIs are replaceable resources, not authorities.
MCP is a tool/access surface only.
No provider grants F06 worker authority.
CAS and F07 remain independent artifact truth boundaries.
Secrets remain server-side and out of evidence.

notes: HTTP adapters use bounded request timeouts and bounded response reads.
External provider endpoints are fixed to documented hosts in this wave.

changes: Added typed External API contracts and provider registry.
Added OpenAlex, arXiv, Semantic Scholar, Crossref and DOI-scoped Unpaywall Reach adapters.
Added Perplexity remote Streamable HTTP MCP client and Reach adapter.
Documented SDLC, security, attribution and truth-boundary rules.
verificationPlan: Require CI and Team Change Gate to pass before merge.
Run provider-specific live proofs only with explicit configured credentials.
Keep unverified providers such as VidWords outside runtime promotion.
Continue remaining API waves as separate SDLC slices.
notes: This PR intentionally does not claim live API qualification.
Hugging Face remains PARTIAL until its existing stub adapter is replaced.
VidWords remains UNVERIFIED because a current official endpoint contract was not independently confirmed.
Team Change Gate disposition is PASS for the change report schema; repository CI and provider live qualification remain separate gates.
